blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) has issued guidelines on wage payments for employees during the Nov. 16-18 special non-working days declared in Metro Manila for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. In Labor Advisory No. 16, series of 2026, Dole noted that the “no work, no pay” rule applies if an employee does not work, unless the company has a policy or collective bargaining agreement that provides for payment on the said days.
